rationale: SLICE round 2 for the round-5 design (replaces the old plan). Round 1 (0.2 mm layers, 3 perimeters, 8/8 layers) ended the ring at Z 16.2 and left a 0.5 mm strip of 25 % gyroid in the middle of the 3 mm wall on every layer above the tabs; round 2 fixes both. Profiles: stock MK3S printer, 0.20mm QUALITY @MK3 and Prusament PETG from config/printer.json; filament_type PETG = print_requirements, spec 6 and the brief. Temperatures stay in the filament profile (240/250 C nozzle, 85/90 C bed, fan 30-50 %: inside 230-250 / 80-90 and the skill's PETG range). No library rows: no flow, temperature or xy compensation overrides. Requirements: fill 25 % gyroid (min 25, equals gyroid), layer 0.15 (max 0.2), perimeters 4 (min 3), top and bottom 11 (min 4). Layer height 0.15: with the 0.2 mm first layer, 0.2 + 106 x 0.15 = 16.10 mm, so the ring's top lands exactly on the designed 16.1 and the running gap under the turntable is the designed 0.4 mm (0.3 with tape), with no sanding; at 0.2 mm layers PrusaSlicer ends it at 16.2 (gap 0.3, 0.2 with tape, below spec 8's 0.3-0.4). 0.15 is inside the skill's 0.15-0.20 range. The tab top lands at 3.05 instead of 3.0, leaving 2.45 instead of 2.5 mm of M3 x 6 thread in the base plate; that advisory row is why the guide says snug, no harder. Perimeters 4: arachne fills the 3.0 / 2.5 mm wall with perimeters, so the wall the ring bears on is solid. Top and bottom 11 is a strength decision: the 3.05 mm tabs (20 layers) print solid all through, 11 from the bed and 11 down from the tab's top face. Strength round 5's verdict row is the Ø7 washer bearing on the tab under the 150 N snug preload, sustained (SF 4.72 against 4 at the solid 25 MPa allowable), and round 4 failed on creep there; with 4 + 4 layers the washer would sit on 0.8 mm of skin over 25 % gyroid. Elephant-foot 0.2 pairs with the 0.4 mm bed chamfer and keeps the tabs flat on the base plate. Seam: aligned (stock, stated): the ring's round walls have no corner, so their seams line up in one vertical line on each wall; the inner and outer walls touch nothing (the turntable bears on the top face), and on the tab outlines the seams go to the tab-ring corners. Supports off: mesh_check 0.33 % overhang, the bottom chamfer's 44-45 degree facets only, no bridges. No brim: 719 mm2 of contact on a 16 mm tall ring, PETG barely warps, and a brim would fill the bed chamfer. Copies 1 (spec 7), one plate, limit 3 h.
